Research position overview

ICGEB's South African Women in Biotechnology programme supports eligible women pursuing a PhD at its Cape Town component. It is a targeted national funding route for biotechnology research, with a monthly stipend and UCT tuition support.

Research Areas

  • Biotechnology
  • Life sciences
  • Doctoral research

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryZAR 16,500/month plus UCT tuition

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilitySouth African women
Further conditionsSouth African women only; biotechnology research in Cape Town.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round20 October 2026
LocationSouth Africa
Details checked9 October 2026

About International Centre for Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology (ICGEB)

ICGEB supports biotechnology research and training through its research components. Its South African Women in Biotechnology programme funds eligible women pursuing doctoral research at its Cape Town component.
